answer: Vesting lockup resists sybils: every reward an agent earns unlocks linearly across a 100-epoch horizon, so a fraudster spinning up a nebula of fake identities cannot liquidate any of them before honest graders detect the collusion and slash the stake. Each frozen clone payout becomes a worthless relic. Attacker cost scales as identity-count times capital locked for the full vesting window, so no hit-and-run cash-out is possible.
